crossRefs.note: The king said to Doeg, “Turn and attack the priests!” Doeg the Edomite turned, and he attacked the priests, and he…
He struck Nob, the city of the priests, with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and nursing babies…
And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets…

translations.web: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.
translations.bsb: You love every word that devours, O deceitful tongue.
translations.kjv: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.
translations.asv: Thou lovest all devouring words, thou deceitful tongue.
